subject: Oceanography
title: Sustainable Fisheries
description: Learn Sustainable Fisheries in one minute.

hook.text: Well-managed fisheries can feed the world indefinitely—but only 65% of stocks are fished sustainably.

buildup.text: Science-based catch limits ensure fish reproduce faster than they're caught—maintaining healthy populations.

discovery.text: Countries like Iceland, Norway, and New Zealand show that strict management leads to thriving fisheries and economies.

twist.text: Certification programs (like MSC) help consumers choose sustainable seafood—but cover only 15% of the global catch.

climax.text: Rebuilding overfished stocks could increase annual catch by 16 million tons—feeding millions more people.

punchline.text: The ocean can feed us forever—if we let the fish reproduce.

quiz.question: What percentage of fish stocks are fished sustainably?
